name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 13, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Fran Jensen, member of Woman’s Club of Vista.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring the week of May 18 - 24, 2014, to be "Public Works Week" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Proclamation declaring May to be "Bike to Work Month," and Friday, May 16, 2014, "National Bike to Work Day" in the City of Vista.
P4.
Presentation promoting tap water by Roy Coox, General Manager of Vista Irrigation District.
P2.
Proclamation declaring May to be "National Building Safety Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review (CC/BSD/SA)
C4.
Engineer’s Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2014/15 (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2014- , Landscape and Lighting District No.1;
2.
Resolution No. 2014- , Street Maintenance District No. 1;
3.
Resolution No. 2014- , South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District; and
4.
Direct staff to set a Public Hearing for June 10, 2014.
C5.
Collection of Delinquent 2013 Weed Abatement Charges (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , declaring the intent to set a Public Hearing to consider the imposition of levy assessments on the 2014 property tax roll; and
2.
Direct staff to set the Public Hearing for June 10, 2014.
C6.
Collection of Delinquent Fiscal Year 2013/14 Property Related Administrative Citations (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , declaring the intent to set a Public Hearing to consider the imposition of levy assessments on the 2014 property tax roll; and
2.
Direct staff to set the Public Hearing for June 10, 2014.
C7.
First Amendment to Amended and Restated Agreement for Ownership, Operation, and Maintenance of the Vista/Carlsbad Interceptor Sewer. (CC)
C8.
Sewer System Management Plan Recertification (CC/BSD)
C9.
Agreement with Vista Irrigation District (VID) to Construct a Water Line (CC)
C10.
First Amendment to As-Needed Agreement for Water Quality Program Implementation Support Services (CC)
C11.
City Council Policy No. 600-04, Vacation of Public Streets and Service Easements (CC)
C12.
CIP No. 8225 Street Construction and Overlay Award of Contract (CC/BSD)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , awarding a construction contract to ATP General Engineering Contractors;
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the Capital Project (CIP) Budget for FY 2013/14; and
3.
Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- , amending the CIP Budget for FY 2013-14.
C13.
Accepting Previously Rejected Offers of Dedication on Map 14264 (CC)
C14.
Emergency Medical Services Billing Services Agreement (CC)
C15.
Appointment to Fill an Unscheduled Vacancy on the Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Advisory Board (CC)
C16.
2014-2018 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Consolidated Plan and 2014-2015 Annual Action Plan (CC)
C17.
Purchase and Sale Agreement of Monte Vista Drive Property (CC)
C18.
Rejection of House Resolution (HR) 29 (Gomez) Outsourcing of Public Services (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Draft Fiscal Year 2014/15 Operating Budget (CC/BSD/CDC)
D2.
Fiscal Year 2013/14 Third Quarter Financial Report (CC/BSD)
1.
Receive the report;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 Operating Budget;
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 Capital Improvement Program (CIP) Budget;
4.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2014- , amending the FY 2013/14 CIP; and
5.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index.
D3.
Newspaper Street Vendor Program (CC)
D4.
Disability Access Icon (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Public Hearing for the Vacation of a Portion of Thibodo Road (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing regarding the vacation of a portion of Thibodo Road; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2014- , vacating a public street easement on a portion of Thibodo Road.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
